mentions.name: Singtrace
mentions.description: This mobile app helps users practice singing. The free version lets users record their vocals and keep an archive of daily practice sessions for each song, while the paid version adds analysis of the user's vocals.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I recently made a mobile app for practicing singing: https://singtrace.karamagic.com

The free version you can record and keep an archive of your daily practices of each song, while a paid version does some analysis of your vocals.
mentions.author: godot
